name: Sumo Deadlift
common_faults: hips shooting up before bar breaks floor

substitutions.note: narrower stance; more low-back and less adductor demand
neutral grip; less low-back shear; more quad

contraindications: acute hip injury aggravated by external rotation
resistance_profile: hardest off the floor with a shorter bar path than conventional; leverage advantage near lockout

provenance.notes: Greater adductor and hip abductor demand than conventional. Bar path shorter due to upright torso. Systemic fatigue heuristic—similar to conventional at high loads.
